transfer_tensor_to_cuda: transfer PyTorch CPU tensors to CUDA device asynchronously using a dedicated CUDA stream
transfer_tensor_with_caching: transfer a batch of tensors to GPU while maintaining a configurable number of batch caches
recursive_apply_to_containers: recursively apply a function to nested lists, tuples, dicts, and dataclasses containing tensors
pin_memory_and_transfer: pin tensor memory and transfer to GPU device in non-blocking asynchronous mode
create_data_transfer_stream: create a thread-local CUDA stream for overlapping data transfer with GPU computation
